short_description: Collect Your Money & Track Debts with AI for African Businesses
full_description:
Netify na the number one AI Business Command Center wey help African SMEs and business owners recover their money sharp-sharp.

Main Features:
• Business Command Center: See wetin need your attention today — money wey outside, customers wey delay, and payment promises for today.
• Multilingual AI Copilot: Talk to Netify for Naija Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, or English. Ask who dey owe you pass make e bring the exact facts from your records.
• Respectful Debt Reminders: Draft correct WhatsApp and SMS reminder messages with proper African business respect.
• Business Memory: Track how each customer dey pay, promises wey dem make, and history.
• Strong Security: Secure fingerprint and Face ID login on Samsung Galaxy phones.

Take total control of your business money with Netify.
